subject: Re: COSTAR status: repro done, M5 scaling risk
body:
Linnea, Alina,

Decision: option (a). Pre-generate M5 to disk, take the ~2TB storage hit - Alina confirmed Corpus has headroom for it outside the migration-sensitive paths. Cutting M5 would leave us with only medical-flavored benchmarks, and the platform customers we're pitching are mostly retail/demand-planning shaped, so M5 is the eval they'll actually believe.

Constraint: the pre-generation job runs this month, not July. July is reserved for Carmen's ablation grid and the MIMIC-III eval, and I don't want storage jobs competing with that. Jorge, please pause the last 30% of the feature-store spike for one week and help Amara with the generation pipeline - the spike resumes June 22.

I'm moving the Q3 handoff review from July 17 to July 20 (end of window) to buy margin. Nothing else moves.

Dmitri
